caption: The video captures a white rectangular pillow lying on a patch of charred, ash-covered ground outdoors, surrounded by dry leaves, dirt, and some green moss at the frame edges. A large dark-brown scorch mark with a feathered edge spreads across much of the pillow's visible face while orange flames burn continuously along its left side and bottom edge. A small blue flame appears near the lower-left corner and persists through the excerpt. The flames flicker and shift shape frame to frame, sometimes rising higher along the left edge and sometimes hugging the lower edge, but the burning zone remains present. The pillow itself stays fixed in position and orientation on the ground, showing no collapse or movement. The surrounding ash and leaves remain unchanged and the camera view holds steady throughout.
